label: Washington Accord knowledge indicators (WK1–WK9), 2021 revision
source_document: Washington Accord graduate attributes and professional competency profiles, 2021 revision, as adopted by NBA GAPC v4.0
verification_note: Transcribed from the 2021 Washington Accord revision. Structurally correct — nine indicators, with WK9 covering ethics and inclusive conduct newly introduced — but not checked word for word against either the IEA document or the NBA GAPC v4.0 manual that adopts it. These statements appear in SAR CO-PO-WK mapping tables, so a verifier must confirm each against the official text and set verified_on.
notes: SAR 2025 expects a CO-PO-WK mapping. A knowledge indicator is a third mapping dimension alongside programme and programme-specific outcomes rather than a property of either, which is why these are defined here and only cross-referenced from the outcome set.

knowledge_indicators.title: Natural sciences
knowledge_indicators.statement: A systematic, theory-based understanding of the natural sciences applicable to the discipline and awareness of relevant social sciences.

knowledge_indicators.title: Mathematics and analysis
knowledge_indicators.statement: Conceptually-based mathematics, numerical analysis, data analysis, statistics and formal aspects of computer and information science to support detailed analysis and modelling applicable to the discipline.

knowledge_indicators.title: Engineering fundamentals
knowledge_indicators.statement: A systematic, theory-based formulation of engineering fundamentals required in an engineering discipline.

knowledge_indicators.title: Specialist knowledge
knowledge_indicators.statement: Engineering specialist knowledge that provides theoretical frameworks and bodies of knowledge for an accepted practice area in the engineering discipline, much of it at the forefront of the discipline.

knowledge_indicators.title: Design knowledge
knowledge_indicators.statement: Knowledge, including efficient resource use, environmental impacts, whole-life cost, re-use of resources, net zero carbon, and similar concepts, that supports engineering design and operations in a practice area.

knowledge_indicators.title: Engineering practice
knowledge_indicators.statement: Knowledge of engineering practice (technology) in the practice areas in the engineering discipline.

knowledge_indicators.title: Engineering in society
knowledge_indicators.statement: Knowledge of the role of engineering in society and identified issues in engineering practice in the discipline, such as the professional responsibility of an engineer to public safety and sustainable development.

knowledge_indicators.title: Research literature
knowledge_indicators.statement: Engagement with selected knowledge in the current research literature of the discipline, awareness of the power of critical thinking and creative approaches to evaluate emerging issues.

knowledge_indicators.title: Ethics and inclusive conduct
knowledge_indicators.statement: Ethics, inclusive behaviour and conduct. Knowledge of professional ethics, responsibilities, and norms of engineering practice. Awareness of the need for diversity by reason of ethnicity, gender, age, physical ability etc. with mutual understanding and respect, and of inclusive attitudes.
